protocol.initialization: same R43A best, fresh AdamW/scaler, all original and adapter parameters trainable
protocol.lr_rule: 5% successful-update warmup, then fixed cosine; replaces validation-driven plateau
protocol.best_rule: strict minimum validation macro_vs_sbs_pct, including step0
protocol.screen: C2 best beats C0 and C1 by delta_screen, and mean of last up-to-five common nonzero validation points is lower than both
protocol.test_rule: only after stage A passes and all stage B arms finish; one locked best per run

metadata.size_source: node_mask.sum(-1); matches loader n; CVRP/MVRP includes the single depot
metadata.normalization_fit: train metadata only; equal weight per task-instance

existing_conditioning: additive problem/constraint/scale/stats condition token in instance attention; solver ID and 34 features enter solver stream; no equivalent multiplicative post-encoder node adapter

paper.borrowed: EPNet/PPNet channel modulation; not a full reproduction
paper.project_adaptations: GELU, metadata-only gate, bottleneck residual, zero Up/GateOut, no content detach, one insertion
